paper_title: Search for Dark Matter Axions with CAST-CAPP
notes: CAST-CAPP haloscope search for galactic DM axions, 4.774-5.434 GHz (19.74-22.47 ueV). Paper explicitly states best exclusion g_agamma = 8e-14 GeV^-1 at 90% CL, reached near ~22 ueV where phase-matching was predominantly used. No numerical table provided; other data points are approximate reconstructions of the exclusion curve from the abstract/text and Fig. 5 description (typical limit a few 1e-13 across the band with the dip to 8e-14 near 22 ueV). Assumes local DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and virialized Maxwell-Boltzmann halo. | selector: text (sole candidate) | axis-peek for confusable-family text read (#625 Phase 3c)
